items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: he got me to work with him out in the kill.

ctx.x: Edgar Benwell. There's a little story behind working with him. We were playing out in the kill. Kill, Mississippi. Uh-huh. Well, naturally I used to come up down the railroad. It didn't cost me anything. I had free transportation. I had to come out here. And, uh, he got me to work with him out in the kill. So, every Saturday, after I knocked on work, I'd come out here and we'd go out to the kill and play. So, it happened to be... One weekend we had a terrific rain storm, I'd say. It started beginning about…
Is that...is that...is that...is that cutting you off, but is that, uh, when he came for me out there and I wouldn't go?
